device.name: Global Shutter Camera
device.note: system_profiler SPCameraDataType reports 'Global Shutter Camera', which is how identify.py recognises the pair by identity. It does NOT give an OpenCV index: no macOS device listing enumerates in OpenCV's order, so identify.elp_indices finds them by opening each index and checking it delivers 1280x800. Chroma is identically zero in every pixel -- it is a true mono sensor, which is why segment.py's dark appearance cannot gate on colour.

modes.verdict: exceeds the asked rate; true 0.5x rescale of 1280x800
undershoots badly -- likely a consumer-side ceiling, see modes.py
